summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failure to file its Form 20-F for FY2025 by the due date. The non-compliance is under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The Company has 60 days (until July 17, 2026) to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, an exception may extend to November 11, 2026. If not, the Company may appeal or face delisting. The notice does not impact trading immediately. The event is a notification of potential delisting, not a definitive action.
